meta.source: Texas A&M AgriLife Soil, Water and Forage Testing Laboratory — Soil Fertility Recommendation tables (updated 3-30-2012), soiltesting.tamu.edu
meta.values: Recommended fertilizer to ADD at a given soil-test ppm. N in lbs N, P in lbs P2O5, K in lbs K2O — per acre unless 'units' says per 1000 sqft.
meta.sufficiency_ppm: Lowest soil-test ppm where the recommendation hits 0 = the 'good enough' level for that crop. null means the table never reaches 0 (common for N — nitrate doesn't carry over, so N is basically always recommended).
meta.lookup_rule: Linear-interpolate between listed ppm columns; above the last listed column use the last listed value.
fixes_applied: fiberN page 1: A&M PDF prints row labels one row off (KENAF label had no numbers, orphan number row at bottom). Values shifted up one row — verified against the 25+ ppm continuation page and the ~50 lb N/bale cotton rule.
Blank cells after a 0 filled with 0 (rec is non-increasing).
known_gaps: RICE has no N table — A&M says follow the Texas Rice Production Guidelines.
A few rows stop at a small nonzero value (e.g. GUAR K 5 lbs at 110 ppm) — lookup holds the last value.
COTTON appears in both 'row' (K only) and 'fiber' (N/P/K) — use 'fiber'.
